hints.title: Order Books by Best Price
hints.text: Track highest price for active buy orders and lowest price for active sell orders.

hints.title: Matching Execution Logic
hints.text: For a buy order, match against sell orders with price <= buy price. For a sell order, match against buy orders with price >= sell price.

hints.title: Backlog Summation
hints.text: Accumulate remaining order quantities across both heaps modulo 10^9 + 7.

hints.title: Full Implementation

complexity.whyNaiveFails: Searching through backlog linearly to find matching order prices takes O(n^2) quadratic time.
complexity.spaceTimeTradeoff: Dual heaps process order matches and updates in O(log n) time per transaction.
complexity.interviewerExpectation: Candidate utilizes max-heap for buy orders and min-heap for sell orders with quantity deduction.

solutions.approach: Dual buy max-heap and sell min-heap order book simulation
